title: Order ranked and unranked planned features
preconditions: Fresh planned features have priorities 1, 2 and 0.

steps.action: Inspect the roadmap containing priorities 1, 2 and 0.
steps.expected_result: Positive priorities ascend; the zero-priority feature follows ranked features.

steps.action: Create two additional planned features with equal priority 3 in a known sequence, then inspect their relative order.
steps.expected_result: Their relative order follows creation order.

expected_result: Order ranked and unranked planned features.
